services.name: GO Skydiving
services.desc: We are happy to be considered one of the leading skydiving go-to facilities for residents of Washington DC during the skydiving months, starting from March to November. There are many reasons why Washington DC Skydiving is best experienced with us. One of the main reasons is that we are just 60 miles from Washington DC and this makes us one of the best skydiving facilities near Washington DC. In fact, Skydiving in the city of Washington DC is forbidden due to government regulations. The other reason why people come to us to skydive, even if it is their first time, is because of our extensive experience and spotless safety record. services.name: Ready to Skydive?
services.desc: You feel like you’re flying rather than falling as the air rushes around you on a thrilling two-mile high, 120MPH freefall that lasts up to one minute. Then your instructor will activate your high performance parachute. You then descend slowly over Aberdeen, enjoying unmatched views of the Chesapeake Bay and Baltimore as your instructor makes slow carving turns through the sky, soaring like a bird for about an 8 to 12 minute parachute flight to a nice smooth landing at Harford County Airport. The most scenic skydiving in Baltimore and Washington DC with the best location… Guaranteed! blurb: Guests book a tandem skydive, meet their certified instructor, take a 10 minute airplane flight to jump height, experience a 40-60 second freefall at 120MPH, followed by a 5 minute scenic parachute flight. The whole process usually takes a few hours, budget at least 4-6 hours. Equipment is provided by Skydive Baltimore.
extraNote: weekend reservations highly recommended; weekday reservations required · Harford County Airport, Aberdeen, Maryland
